name: driver_entry_flush_and_wait
desc: Driver jump table entry: flush audio buffer and wait for playback to finish
details: Entry point 2 in the driver dispatch table at offset 000Ah. Performs a far jump to sb_flush_and_wait (0823:11BB), which flushes any partially filled audio buffer to the Sound Blaster DMA playback and spin-waits until playback has completed.

0823:000a.comment: Jump to driver implementation of flush and wait
